title: Proper derived direct image preserves bounded below coherent complexes of Zariski modules
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth] whose underlying topological space is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Work with Zariski sheaves of structure-sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $G\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have coherent cohomology sheaves [pqf-def-coherent] and satisfy $H^j(G)=0$ for all sufficiently negative $j$. Then $Rf_*G\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] has coherent cohomology sheaves, and its cohomology vanishes in all sufficiently negative degrees.

source.place: Tag 0D0B (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), specialized to a proper morphism f, so every cohomology sheaf has proper support.

proof.text: Choose $a\in\mathbf Z$ such that $H^q(G)=0$ for $q<a$, and a representative $K^\bullet$ with $K^q=0$ for $q<a$ by the standard t-structure description. On the small Zariski sites, module sheaves form Grothendieck abelian categories. Module direct image is right adjoint to module pullback, hence preserves finite limits and is left exact; it is additive because direct image acts additively on sections and maps. Thus $v=f_*$ satisfies the hypotheses of the truncation hypercohomology theorem.

source.place: Tag 0D0B (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence, using the spectral-sequence proof of Tag 08E2 (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: Apply the truncation spectral sequence: $E_2^{p,q}=R^pf_*H^q(G)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(Rf_*G)$. The derived image here is precisely module direct image computed on K-injective resolutions, as in the definition of $Rf_*$. The theorem gives $E_r^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$, stabilization in each bidegree, and a filtration $F^pH^n$ with $F^0H^n=H^n$, $F^pH^n=0$ for $p\geq n-a+1$, and $\operatorname{gr}^pH^n\cong E_\infty^{p,n-p}$.

source.place: Tag 0D0B (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence, using the spectral-sequence proof of Tag 08E2 (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: For $p\geq0$, apply proper coherent higher direct image to the coherent module $H^q(G)$. Its hypotheses hold: $f$ is proper, and the Noetherian base $S$ is locally Noetherian. Consequently every $E_2^{p,q}$ with $p\geq0$ is coherent. Terms with $p<0$ are zero by the spectral sequence and hence coherent by zero coherence.

source.place: Tag 0D0B (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence, using the spectral-sequence proof of Tag 08E2 (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: Induct on $r\geq2$ to prove every $E_r^{p,q}$ coherent. The outgoing differential has coherent kernel. The incoming differential factors through this kernel, and $E_{r+1}^{p,q}$ is the cokernel of that factor map; its source and target are coherent, so its cokernel is coherent. Stabilization identifies $E_\infty^{p,q}$ with a finite page. For $n\geq a$, put $N=n-a+1$. Starting from $F^NH^n=0$, descend through $0\to F^{p+1}H^n\to F^pH^n\to E_\infty^{p,n-p}\to0$ for $p=N-1,\ldots,0$. Extension closure proves $H^n(Rf_*G)=F^0H^n$ coherent.

source.place: Tag 0D0B (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence, using the spectral-sequence proof of Tag 08E2 (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: If $n<a$, then $0\geq n-a+1$, so the stated filtration identities give $H^n(Rf_*G)=F^0H^n=0$. This is coherent as well. Thus all cohomology sheaves are coherent and the same integer $a$ is a lower bound for their nonvanishing degrees.
